front.title: A YANG Data Model for PFC Queue Telemetry

abstract.t:
This document defines a YANG data model for completed, per-queue observations of backlog and received Priority-based Flow Control (PFC) gating. Each record identifies a monotonic measurement interval, queue mapping epoch, measurement method, and absolute error bound. The model makes repeated reads, missing coverage, and weighted aggregation explicit.
The measured overlap does not identify the sole cause of queueing delay and does not change PFC, packet scheduling, or ECN marking. The module augments interface operational state and defines no configuration or notification interface.
